title: Manager subscribes only to ops-flags + its own PRs; lanes wake on green (context-overhead cut)
note: Operator 2026-10-25 ~10:25Z (chat, verbatim): "I just want to make sure that the overhead changes aren't putting any work at risk - as long as it's fine that your not subscribed, then let's make that change." Risk check: lanes stay subscribed to their own PRs and fix red CI; lanes wake the manager on green for hold PRs; the 3-hourly check-in lands any green PR waiting on the manager; a lane is never archived while it owns an unmerged PR. Worst case of a missed wake is one check-in interval of merge delay, no dropped work. Rule in .claude/skills/manager/SKILL.md § Manager <-> lane.
